title: Uniqueness in Turán's theorem
statement: Let $V$ be a finite vertex set, let $m \geq 1$, and let $G$ be a simple graph on $V$ that contains no clique on $m+1$ vertices. Write $T$ for the Turán graph $T(|V|, m)$, the complete $m$-partite graph on $|V|$ vertices whose parts differ in size by at most one. If $G$ has exactly as many edges as $T$, then $G$ is isomorphic to $T$.
hypotheses_covered: G has the same number of edges as the Turán graph T(|V|, m)
